documents.content: Vendor Acme Supplies submitted invoice INV-2026-001 for amount 45000 INR. [REF_ACME_01] All compliance checks passed successfully and vendor master records are verified. [REF_ACME_02] Payment is within autonomous authority limits for regular operational expenses. [REF_ACME_03]

Invoice INV-2026-002 from Global Logistics totals 250000 INR. [REF_GLOB_01] Commercial terms are valid and services were rendered, but the amount exceeds the local autonomous threshold. [REF_GLOB_02] Executive managerial sign-off is mandatory before payout. [REF_GLOB_03]

Invoice INV-2026-003 from Tech Solutions for 12000 INR was already settled under previous payment reference TXN-9988. [REF_TECH_01] This submission represents an exact duplicate copy of an already paid invoice. [REF_TECH_02] Immediate rejection is required to prevent double payment. [REF_TECH_03]
